subject: general
question: Which of the following is not an AGMARK qualified product?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold Jewelry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• AGMARK is a certification mark employed on agricultural products in India, ensuring that they conform to a set of standards approved by the Directorate of Marketing and Inspection.
 
• The AGMARK certification is used to guarantee the quality of agricultural products such as honey, spices, pulses, cereals, and essential oils.
 
• Vegetables can also be AGMARK certified to ensure they meet specific quality standards.
 
• Gold Jewelry is a non-agricultural product and does not fall under the purview of AGMARK certification.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AGMARK**

 
 
• AGMARK is a certification mark employed on agricultural products in India by the Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, an agency of the Government of India.
 
• The term AGMARK is a blend of the words 'Ag' (agriculture) and 'Mark' (certification mark).
 
• The AGMARK certification assures that the products conform to a set of standards approved by the Directorate of Marketing and Inspection.
 
• This certification covers various products such as pulses, cereals, essential oils, vegetable oils, fruits and vegetables, and other semi-processed goods.
 
 
 
• **Honey**
 
 
• Honey is a natural sweet substance produced by honey bees from the nectar of flowers.
 
• It can be AGMARK certified to ensure it meets quality standards.
 
• AGMARK certification ensures the honey is pure, unadulterated, and of a certain quality.
 
 
 
• **Spices**
 
 
• Spices are aromatic substances used to flavor food and can include items like turmeric, pepper, cumin, and coriander.
 
• They can be AGMARK certified to assure quality and purity.
 
 
 
• **Vegetables**
 
 
• Vegetables are plant parts consumed by humans as food.
 
• They can also be AGMARK certified to ensure they meet quality and safety standards.
 
 
 
• **Gold Jewelry**
 
 
• Gold Jewelry is made from gold and is used as personal adornment.
 
• It does not fall under the agricultural products category and hence is not covered by AGMARK certification.
 
• Gold Jewelry quality is typically certified by hallmarking, which is a separate certification process.
